title: The Long Road to Dire Dawa
audience: Anyone who wants to hear the story of my first visit to Dire Dawa: family, friends, and Ethiopians at home and abroad who know the road east.
intent: By the end they should feel the length and heat of my first journey to Dire Dawa, my mother's family's home, the warmth of a family pushing an old car through it together, and why we made the trip: to stand before Saint Gabriel at Kulubi.

style.visual_prefix: Warm nostalgic film photograph, soft grain, natural light, 35mm lens, eastern Ethiopia, honest documentary feel.
style.negative: text, watermark, logo, distorted hands, extra fingers, cartoon, oversaturated, modern cars in the foreground
style.palette: highland greens fading to dusty ochre lowlands, white netela cloth, dark volcanic rock

characters.description: a blue-green (teal) early-1990s Hyundai Elantra sedan with faded paint, a roof rack with a tied-down bag, Ethiopian number plate
the narrator, a young Ethiopian man with short black hair, wearing a plain light shirt
an Ethiopian father in his fifties, short greying hair, light jacket over a collared shirt
an Ethiopian mother in her fifties wearing a white netela shawl over a dress
the narrator's sister, a young Ethiopian woman with braided hair
the narrator's brother, a young Ethiopian man in a t-shirt

am.style_prompt: Narrate in Amharic, warmly and calmly, like a young man telling his family's story

en.style_prompt: Narrate warmly and calmly, like a young man telling his family's story

shots.purpose: Hook: frame the film as my first trip to Dire Dawa, my mother's family's home.
shots.keyframe_prompt: a family loading bags onto the roof of the car outside a house in Addis Ababa before sunrise, cool blue light, eucalyptus trees
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in as the last bag is tied down

narration.am: ይህ ወደ ድሬዳዋ የመጀመሪያ ጉዞዬ ታሪክ ነው፤ የእናቴ ቤተሰብ ከዚያ ነው።
narration.en: This is the story of my first trip to Dire Dawa, where my mother's family comes from.

shots.purpose: Introduce the five of us, the old car, and why we went: Saint Gabriel's feast at Kulubi.
shots.camera: medium, inside the car from the back seat
shots.keyframe_prompt: inside the car on the highway, the father driving, the mother beside him, the sister and brother in the back seat, open road through the windscreen
shots.motion_prompt: gentle handheld sway, road moving past the windows

narration.am: አምስታችን በአሮጌዋ ኤላንትራ ወደ ቁልቢ ገብርኤል ክብረ በዓል እያመራን ነበር።
narration.en: Five of us in our old Elantra, heading for Saint Gabriel's feast at Kulubi.

shots.purpose: The road changes the world around us: first sign we are far from home.
shots.camera: wide, eye level, from the roadside
shots.keyframe_prompt: a line of camels crossing the highway near Awash, dry acacia scrubland, the car waiting in the distance, hazy midday light
shots.motion_prompt: camels walk slowly across frame from left to right

narration.am: ፊታችን አምስት መቶ ሃያ አምስት ኪሎ ሜትር ነበር። አዋሽ ላይ ግመሎች መንገዱን ተሻገሩ።
narration.en: 525 kilometres lay ahead. At Awash, camels crossed the road as if they owned it.

shots.purpose: A moment of play and curiosity before the hard part of the road.
shots.keyframe_prompt: a troop of baboons sitting on a rock wall at the side of the road near Awash, one young baboon looking straight at the camera
shots.motion_prompt: small head turns, a young baboon scratches and looks up

narration.am: ዝንጀሮዎች ከመንገዱ ዳር ሆነው በጉጉት ያዩን ነበር።
narration.en: Monkeys watched us from the roadside, curious about the travellers.

shots.purpose: Scale of the journey: the landscape becomes dramatic and unfamiliar.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the small blue-green car on a winding road through dark volcanic rocky mountains near Asbe Teferi, layered ridges, late morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slow aerial drift following the car along the road

narration.am: አሰበ ተፈሪ አካባቢ መሬቱ ወደ ጥቁር የእሳተ ገሞራ አለትና ተራራ ተለወጠ።
narration.en: Near Asbe Teferi, the land rose into dark volcanic rock and mountains.

shots.purpose: Rising tension: the climate shifts from highland cool to lowland heat.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of the old car's dashboard temperature gauge needle climbing towards red, heat shimmer on the road ahead through the windscreen, dusty lowland
shots.motion_prompt: the needle creeps up, heat haze ripples on the road

narration.am: ከዚያ መንገዱ ወደ ቆላው ወረደ፤ ሙቀቱም አብሮ መጣ።
narration.en: Then the road dropped toward the lowlands, and the heat came with it.

shots.purpose: The crisis: the car gives out in the heat.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the car pulled over on the side of a hot dusty lowland road, bonnet open, steam rising from the engine, the family stepping out into the sun
shots.motion_prompt: steam billows from the engine, slow push-in

narration.am: አሮጌዋ መኪናችን አልቻለችም። ከሞተሩ እንፋሎት ይወጣ ጀመር።
narration.en: Our old car could not take it. Steam rose from the engine.

shots.purpose: The heart of the film, the moment I remember most: my father cooling the engine by hand.
shots.camera: medium close-up, over the open bonnet
shots.keyframe_prompt: the father pouring water from a yellow jerrycan onto the hot engine and radiator of the car, steam bursting up, the narrator holding a second jerrycan beside him, bright harsh sun
shots.motion_prompt: water pours and steam bursts up, very slow push-in

narration.am: በየጥቂት ኪሎ ሜትሩ እንቆማለን፤ አባቴ ሞተሩን ለማቀዝቀዝ ውሃ ያፈስበታል።
narration.en: Every few kilometres we stopped, and my father poured water on the engine to cool it.

shots.purpose: What the memory really means: the family together, waiting, not the breakdown.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the whole family resting together in the thin shade of an acacia tree beside the parked car, the mother sharing bread, everyone laughing, hot afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: static camera, leaves move, the family laughs

narration.am: በጣም የማስታውሰው ያንን ነው፤ ሁላችንም አብረን በመንገድ ዳር ስንጠብቅ።
narration.en: That is what I remember most: all of us, waiting together by the road.

shots.purpose: Release: we made it to Dire Dawa, my mother's hometown.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the car driving into Dire Dawa at dusk, warm street lights, palm trees, bajaj taxis, the sky orange and violet
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking shot alongside the car

narration.am: ቀስ በቀስ፣ ቆም እያልን፣ የእናቴ ከተማ ድሬዳዋ ደረስን።
narration.en: Slowly, stop by stop, we reached Dire Dawa, my mother's hometown.

shots.purpose: The reason for the journey: standing together at Kulubi Gabriel among the pilgrims.
shots.keyframe_prompt: seen from behind, the family standing among thousands of pilgrims dressed in white netela at Kulubi Gabriel church on its hilltop, morning light, umbrellas and candles
shots.motion_prompt: slow rise and pull-back revealing the crowd and the church

narration.am: ቁልቢ ላይም በነጭ ከለበሱ በሺዎች መካከል፣ በአንድነት በቅዱስ ገብርኤል ፊት ቆምን።
narration.en: And at Kulubi, among thousands in white, we stood together before Saint Gabriel.
